items.title: JPMorgan Expects Third-Quarter Gains in Investment Banking, Markets
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase is expecting growth in the “mid- to high-teens” for both investment-banking fees and markets revenue in the third quarter compared with the year-ago period, co-president Doug Petno said Tuesday.  “In investment banking…we started the year with a strong pipeline, we started this quarter with a strong pipeline,” Petno said at a financial services conference hosted by Barclays.  Petno said the bank, which is due to report third-quarter earnings on Oct. 13, is expecting lower markets revenue compared with its record-setting second quarter.
